 Description and Requirements
   

  

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 Business Unit

This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.

 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.

The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.

* Experience designing, implementing, administering, or supporting AI\-enabled business processes, agents, knowledge repositories, or research solutions.
* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.

**Company Description** 
 SAI CROP\-SCIENCE PRIVATE LIMITED is an agriculture\-focused company headquartered on Purna Das Road in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The organization operates in the Greater Kolkata Area, serving regional crop producers and agricultural businesses. It is positioned to support farmers and stakeholders with products and advisory services that enhance crop health and productivity. As the company grows, it offers opportunities for professionals interested in working directly with the agricultural sector and contributing to sustainable farming practices.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Micronutrient Consultant role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The Micronutrient Consultant will advise farmers and agribusiness clients on the appropriate use of micronutrient fertilizers and soil amendments to improve crop yield and quality. Day\-to\-day tasks include conducting field visits, assessing soil and crop conditions, recommending suitable micronutrient products and application methods, and monitoring results over the growing season. The role involves preparing technical reports, maintaining detailed records of recommendations and outcomes, and collaborating with internal teams on product development and improvement. The consultant will also provide training sessions and demonstrations, support sales colleagues with technical expertise, and stay up to date with the latest agronomic research and regulatory requirements.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of agronomy, soil science, plant nutrition, and micronutrient management for major crops.
* Experience in field advisory work, including conducting farm visits, crop inspections, and soil sampling.
* Ability to interpret soil and tissue test reports and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for working with farmers, dealers, and internal teams.
* Basic proficiency in data recording, report writing, and use of common office and field documentation tools.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Agriculture, Agronomy, Soil Science, Plant Science, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience in fertilizer, crop protection, or agricultural input industry is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel frequently within the Greater Kolkata Area and work in field conditions.
